source: Pronunciation guide from the original Fun With Klallam page
note: Starter rows for the pronunciation sheet. English only; the symbols are typed by a speaker.

sounds.description: Schwa — like "uh" in "above" (often drops in fast speech)
Throaty "h" — deep in the throat (uvular fricative)
Velar "hw" — like blowing with rounded lips
Voiceless lateral — like Welsh "ll" or breathed "hl"
"k" sounds pronounced far back in the throat
Ejective stops — the same sounds with a sharp release burst
Accent mark = stressed vowel — louder and slightly longer
Glottalized sonorants — tense your throat while saying them
